mandate_changed: Your manager revised your responsibility. The current mandate in your standing instructions replaces the earlier mandate. Update profile.md if your responsibilities changed; if the new mandate significantly changes your direction, put away or park superseded work first (deliverables, mail, reminders and any affected direct reports), then either proceed or — when stale context would get in the way and this is not your final temporary work period — call handoff (next="continue" if work under the new mandate is ready now, next="wait" if waiting on input, and clean_up=True when scratch and Docker work are done).
temporary: Remaining allocated work periods (including this one): ${remaining}. Size your approach to fit this budget. Ending your final period clears ~/scratch and pauses your role until your manager renews or makes it permanent—no mail, access grant, reminder or handoff can wake you once your periods are spent—so save deliverables and reusable notes to your workspace or shared/ on the firm drive, send your result, and tell your manager before finishing if a blocker or remaining work will need renewal. This work period may finish normally.

owner_fresh_route: The owner reopened your work with fresh working memory.
renew_temporary: Your manager renewed your allocated work periods.
promote: Your manager made your appointment permanent.
authorized_retry: Your manager or owner authorized another attempt.
dependency_recovery: Operations is retrying work after a shared service interruption.
guidance_changed: The role guidance in your standing instructions has changed and replaces any you had before.
idle_inbox_review: Review newly offered unread mail while the firm has no runnable ordinary work.
idle_review_instructions:
## Idle inbox review

Look through the offered unread mail, reading it in full or as a summary as useful. Act only where useful, and dismiss what needs nothing. This snapshot lists only newly offered mail; peek shows the whole inbox. Reading records receipt, not completed work: keep unfinished commitments in working memory or handoff notes. Do not send acknowledgment-only replies or repeat status updates just because this review happened. Once you have read or dismissed what was offered and nothing needs further work, finish normally.
recent_reads: Recently read mail (reading does not prove its work is finished):
